g.text: Shared Run admission - prepare, then commit
and credential references for this Run
Record failure only if task / Run still exist
Fix the proposed Session ID for this Run
Register Session ownership by resource IDs and grant
No user / tenant / owner supplied by Claw
Durable binding confirmed, rejected or unknown
Stop admission; reconcile by fixed IDs
Do not create another Session or replay business
Prepare Agent, model and CRON context
Reuse fixed Session ID; no business execution
One short database transaction, coordinated by Schedule
Recheck task, claim, grant, time and capacity
Create Session + first message + root + Run link
Record failure only if task / Run still exist
Mate binding is independent; there is no cross-database transaction.
A failed Claw transaction leaves a binding to reconcile, not a Session.
Admission uses Runtime persistence inside the same transaction.
An accepted Run keeps its prepared context for dispatch.
No model or tool execution occurs in this sequence.
